title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the strategic resolution and intelligence runtime.
BNDY Backline is the capability/product name; bndy-enrichment remains the single strategic Backline runtime rather than creating a parallel repository.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.
BNDY Backline is the durable intelligence substrate: immutable evidence plus observations and atomised claims feed policy and projection; the graph is a derived view, not the authority.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. The workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Strategic Backline runtime for source acquisition, immutable evidence, observations, atomised claims, identity resolution, authority, projection, Capture processing and enrichment.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

lanes.title: BNDY Backline
lanes.objective: Make sources produce evidence and atomised claims; let policy derive BNDY truth.

done.title: Target architecture defined
done.detail: bndy-enrichment documents Observation, Extraction, Interpretation, Claim, EvidencePack, authority policy, tombstones and projection workers.

done.title: Durable knowledge substrate exists
done.detail: Immutable source evidence is stored in the existing S3 EvidenceBucket. Observation, Claim, Source Registry/State and Tombstone records live in the existing DynamoDB StateTable; WP-02 deliberately added no new DynamoDB table.

done.title: Claims are atomised database records
done.detail: A Claim is one subject-predicate-value assertion linked back to an Observation/evidence source. Claims are single-copy durable records with indexes by observation and subject, rather than duplicated whole Artist/Venue/Event documents.

done.title: Graph is a derived view, not the authority
done.detail: The KLMA vertical slice materialises graph.json and graph.html from claims and can add resolved canonical BNDY nodes. Future Neptune is explicitly allowed only as a projection/index; S3 evidence plus DynamoDB observations/claims remain authoritative.

done.title: Strategic projection worker exists
done.detail: The projection engine consumes durable Claims, applies predicate-specific authority, owner protection and tombstones, then writes through canonical BNDY APIs with read-back verification.

done.title: KLMA dual-path vertical slice proven
done.detail: A live KLMA source fetch has been proven through Observation + Claims + graph-shaped knowledge and additive canonical BNDY projection with production read-back verification.

done.title: Capture interpretation runs in Enrichment
done.detail: Facebook events and posters already use the newer enrichment runtime for resolution.

done.title: Canonical APIs remain the write boundary
done.detail: Artist, venue and event uniqueness/dedupe is enforced centrally.

done.title: Canonical BNDY baseline complete
done.detail: The existing BNDY corpus is now represented in Backline in shadow mode: 15,288 logical entities and Observations, 518,131 Claims, 15,288 Resolutions and 15,288 immutable evidence objects, with zero recorded baseline errors.

done.title: National Lemonrock evidence corpus operating in AWS
done.detail: The national Lemonrock source family is producing immutable evidence, Observations and Claims in shadow mode. This is a substantial live corpus, but it is deliberately not marked complete until bootstrap recovery and a successful full national reconciliation pass the owned completion gates.

done.title: Initial Backline Explorer deployed
done.detail: The authenticated Godmode Explorer can inspect Lemonrock task progress, source observations and subject Claims. It is an operational inspector, not yet the planned entity-resolution and evidence graph.

now.title: Lemonrock is Backline's first national flagship source
now.detail: The committed plan deliberately bootstraps the complete discoverable UK Lemonrock artist, venue and future-gig universe into source-native identities, immutable evidence and rich Claims before selective canonical projection.

now.title: BNDY Backline is a logical layer, not another app
now.detail: It lives inside the bndy-enrichment AWS runtime: Source Registry/Runner + S3 evidence + DynamoDB observations/claims + queues/workers + projection policy. The public BNDY database remains the canonical product projection, not the intelligence store.

now.title: Dual-path operating rule
now.detail: Building durable evidence/claims must not delay live gig publication. A trusted source can create claims and immediately project through canonical BNDY APIs while BNDY Backline keeps the evidence history for later reconciliation.

now.title: Source authority is source-specific
now.detail: KLMA is a controlled enduring community calendar and can support immediate additive projection. GigsNews is a human-curated weekly aggregation, so absence from a later page is not by itself cancellation evidence.

now.title: Two generations of claims thinking exist
now.detail: bndy-signals contains the older cognitive runtime; bndy-enrichment/BNDY Backline contains the strategic architecture.

now.title: Complete national Lemonrock ingestion
now.detail: Own the work through failed-task recovery, successful full national reconciliation, zero unexplained gaps and verified recurring diffs. Completion is controlled by the gates in the existing Lemonrock plan.

now.title: Persist Lemonrock identity resolution
now.detail: Turn source-native Artist, Venue and Gig evidence into explicit resolved, unresolved or conflicted identity state. Evidence volume alone is not yet an operational graph.

now.title: Build the real Godmode evidence graph
now.detail: Extend the read-only API and Explorer from task/Claim inspection to bounded traversal across Sources, source identities, canonical entities, Claims, Observations, conflicts and projection decisions.

now.title: Prepare shadow projection comparison
now.detail: After completeness and resolution, derive explainable best-supported values and compare them with canonical BNDY without enabling mass writes.

next.title: Controlled Backline projection
next.detail: Enable only a bounded high-confidence cohort through canonical APIs with read-back, owner protection, stop thresholds and recorded projection decisions.

next.title: Converge BNDY-originated changes
next.detail: Extend durable Backline provenance from the new user-created Artist path to Venue, Event, Festival, Capture and assisted-creation changes after parity gates.

next.title: Migrate useful Signals concepts
